tutorial.name: Build and Run the Holoscan Yocto Demo on AGX Thor
tutorial.description: Build a custom Yocto Linux image with Holoscan SDK 5, flash a Jetson AGX Thor devkit, run the installed C++ hello-world example, check the Python bindings, and optionally run the SDK test suite.

hardware.name: x86-64 Ubuntu 24.04 host
hardware.description: Native host for building and flashing, with at least 400 GB of free disk space, 32 GB of RAM (64 GB recommended), and Internet access

hardware.name: NVIDIA Jetson AGX Thor devkit
hardware.description: Devkit with its power supply and a USB-C cable connecting the host to the recovery port

hardware.name: Monitor
hardware.description: Connected to the board with a graphical session running for optional display tests; otherwise those tests are skipped
